text: Continuous chlorination of the seawater at 0.5 mg/l with pulse dosing to 2 mg/l, and a residual oxidant of up to 0.2 mg/l in the condenser and the CW outlet piping (dosing controlled on the outfall seal-pit value, DEC-EPCE-0015), shall be taken as the oxidant exposure of all wetted materials downstream of the dosing point; materials shall be tolerant of free chlorine at those levels without a loss of pitting resistance.
